human_egress_approval.destination: OpenAI/Codex service using the configured account
human_egress_approval.scope: Frozen T023/MG1-v3 prompts and materialized candidate Skill/reference contents for the required 480 live trials.

isolation.inspection: Primary Codex session metadata was filtered by this run's exact disposable-workspace prefix; parent/guardian sessions and unrelated tasks were excluded.

failed_commands.classification: Synthetic workspace has no AGENTS.md; not a provider/network error.

timeout_trace_audit.recovery: Visible tool-call/result evidence recovered from the exact primary persisted Codex session; system/developer instructions and private reasoning were not exported.

context_evidence.claim_scope: Host-specific successful candidate-file reads; UTF-8 bytes, not exact tokens or whole-session context.
context_evidence.selection_metric: observed_context_bytes = unique successful candidate SKILL.md bytes + unique successful candidate reference bytes
context_evidence.reference_metric: loaded_reference_bytes is host-read diagnostic evidence only
context_evidence.rfo_compatible_evidence: Per-trial activated_entrypoints and loaded_reference_paths identify distinct successfully read candidate artifacts.
context_evidence.navigation_evidence: Raw tool traces retain the observed Skill-to-local-reference read sequence.
context_evidence.limitations: No complete-matrix context comparison, whole-host TMC/CAR, exact-token claim, or cross-host routing portability claim is made.

distribution_evidence.feasibility_scope: Architectural/materialization evidence only; final platform-specific single-install and wrapper proof remains T024/T029.

required_reentry: Orchestrator must persist disposition/recovery authority for the unclassified incomplete trial before any continuation or new experiment. No threshold, prompt, presentation, or model/effort change is proposed.
